title: Remote channels
intro: Connect a channel to view TeamBuddy tasks remotely and send instructions.
hint: In a remote channel bot conversation, use /task to view running tasks, /task -a to view all tasks, or /help to view command help. Send {'@'} followed by a task ID to select one.
wechatDescription: View tasks and send instructions from WeChat, and receive execution results in the chat.
wecomDescription: View tasks and send instructions from a WeCom group so teammates can share progress and results.
feishuDescription: View tasks and send instructions through Feishu, and receive updates in the conversation.
dingtalkDescription: View task progress and send instructions from DingTalk conversations.
appDescription: Access the client from your phone to view active tasks and send instructions.
needVerify: Enter the verification code shown in WeChat
expired: The QR code expired. Refresh and try again.
connectFailed: Could not connect WeChat. Try again.
connectionLost: The WeChat connection is no longer valid. Scan again if you disconnected it in WeChat.
verifyFailed: Could not submit the verification code
disconnectDescription: After stopping the on-device WeChat connection, the client will no longer receive WeChat messages automatically. Click Connect to scan again and re-enable.
disconnectFailed: Could not stop on-device WeChat connection
stopNotifyFailed: On-device connection stopped (could not notify the server). Scan again to reconnect.
statusError: The WeChat connection is having trouble. The client is retrying.
replyMessageIDMissing: WeChat did not return a message_id for the ChatBot reply. This feature may be restricted for the current WeChat account. Check the account status.
uncertainDescription: The outcome of these instructions is uncertain. Check the execution history in task details first. Removing protection will not stop a run that may still be active.
uncertainEmpty: There are no runs to review.
uncertainLoadFailed: Could not load runs to review. Try again.
uncertainConfirmDescription: First verify the execution state for “{task}”. Removing protection does not stop a running CLI or Codex turn. Changing or deleting the task while it is running may make its results inconsistent.
